description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for BiteClub (Rust + Bevy 0.14) — complex regression patterns from deep code review

rules.name: Rust: HashMap/HashSet allocation inside Bevy system without local cache
rules.message: HashMap::new() inside a Bevy system allocates every frame. Use Local<HashMap<...>> to cache the allocation across frames.
rules.suggestion: Add `mut cache: Local<HashMap<Entity, Vec2>>` as a system parameter and .clear() it each frame instead of allocating new.

rules.name: Rust: cfg target_arch wasm32 function with empty body
rules.message: Function gated with #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")] has an empty body — WASM target silently no-ops. Provide an implementation or todo!().
rules.suggestion: Implement using web-sys/wasm-bindgen, or add `todo!("WASM audio — tracking issue #XXX")` to surface the gap.

rules.name: Rust: std::mem::forget on owned resource handle
rules.message: std::mem::forget() on a stream/sink handle leaks it for process lifetime. Store in a Resource or static instead.
rules.suggestion: Wrap in lazy_static! or once_cell::sync::Lazy, or store in a Bevy Resource to keep the handle alive cleanly.

rules.name: Rust: String find() used as JSON key lookup
rules.message: String::find() matches substrings, not exact JSON keys — 'hp' will match 'max_hp'. Use serde for JSON parsing.
rules.suggestion: Replace hand-rolled JSON with serde_json::from_str::<Struct>() and #[derive(Deserialize)].

rules.name: Rust: thread_rng() in system function body
rules.message: rand::thread_rng() in a Bevy system breaks replay determinism. Use ResMut<GameRng> instead.
rules.suggestion: Accept `mut rng: ResMut<GameRng>` as a system parameter and call rng.gen_range() or rng.random().

rules.name: Rust: Relative path literal in File::open/create without absolute resolution
rules.message: File operation with relative path resolves against CWD, not game install dir. Use absolute paths via dirs crate.
rules.suggestion: Build paths from dirs::data_dir().join("biteclub").join("saves/unlocks.json") for portable, CWD-independent saves.

rules.name: Rust: Bevy system with per-frame Vec/HashMap allocation pattern
rules.message: Per-frame collection allocation in Bevy system. Use Local<T> to reuse the buffer across frames.
rules.suggestion: Add `mut buf: Local<Vec<Entity>>` system parameter, call buf.clear() at the top, then reuse.
